Generate a synthetic dataset for clumped isotopes calibrations

Source: R/cal.dataset.R
cal.dataset.Rd

Simulates a calibration dataset with alpha = 0.268 and beta = 0.0369. True temperatures (10^6/T^2) are drawn from a normal distribution with mean 12 and SD 2.

Usage

cal.dataset(error = "S1", nobs = 1000, seed = NULL)

Arguments

error

Error scenario: low (S1), Intermediate (S2), or High (S3)

nobs

Number of observations in the simulated dataset

seed

Optional seed. When given, it is passed to set.seed(), which also sets the seed for the rest of the session.

Value

A data.frame with the true and measured values of Temperature and D47, their errors (1 SD), and Material (always 1).
